findings.comment: Two critical existing recorded easements are not properly identified on the site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (recorded Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior no-build zone) is mislocated and shown with incorrect document number (2010070273); (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner) is not depicted at all. County records confirm both are perpetual easements encumbering the property. Provide correct identification and location of all existing recorded easements affecting the property.

applicableAreas: Property development, easement areas, detention pond location
findings.comment: The Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) is recorded as a perpetual no-build zone covering 0.31 acres in the NE interior. The site plan shows biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, BBQ area, and other improvements in this same NE interior area, but it cannot be verified from available documents whether applicant has reviewed the recorded easement terms to determine compatibility with the proposed development in this area. Provide evidence of easement review and confirmation that proposed improvements do not violate the no-build restriction.

applicableAreas: NE interior area of site, detention pond location
findings.comment: Proposed biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, and associated improvements are located in the NE interior area where the recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, perpetual no-build zone) exists. No documentation of easement vacation, release, or modification authorizing these improvements within the easement boundaries has been provided. The proposed development is not compatible with a perpetual no-build easement without formal easement modification or vacation.

applicableAreas: Western boundary, eastern boundary, site perimeter
findings.comment: Several easements on the site plan have document numbers that are cut off, obscured, or illegible, including Wastewater Easement, Sidewalk Easement (two locations), and Existing Water Line Vault Easement on the western boundary. Additionally, the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement is labeled with an apparently transposed document number (2010070273 shown vs. recorded 2010070731). All easements must be clearly labeled with legible, accurate recording information showing document number and volume/page or instrument number. Revise to ensure all easement labels are complete, legible, and accurate.

applicableAreas: NE corner and eastern portion of site
findings.comment: The City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, NE corner, 0.130 acres, perpetual) required for drainage facilities is not depicted on the drainage or site plan sheets. County records and applicant communication confirm this easement exists and affects the property. The easement must be clearly delineated on site plan showing its location, boundaries, and recording information to demonstrate that development does not conflict with City's right to access and maintain the drainage facility.
